title: Trace export redacts private prompt and contact data
expected_signal: safe trace contains IDs and counts but no prompt, phone, or email
measurement_note: Measured by the local sanitizer test; no provider call is required.

title: Trace exporter outage leaves local evidence and does not fail work
expected_signal: local event is retained and degraded_export is visible
measurement_note: Measured with a failing injected exporter; no external trace service is needed.

title: The orchestration path remains disabled by default
expected_signal: rollout mode is disabled and rollback is not needed
measurement_note: Measured from the explicit rollout decision helper.

title: The trace contains no autonomous publishing action
expected_signal: terminal evidence has no publish, schedule, spend, or external-send tool
measurement_note: Measured against the explicit action allow-list; explanatory text is not treated as an action.

title: Owner resume binds the exact immutable artifact
expected_signal: matching owner/checksum decision resumes; stale decision is rejected
measurement_note: Covered by the Phase 3 and Phase 4 graph tests; the smoke runner may execute either fixture.

title: Quality repair is targeted and capped
expected_signal: only the active specialist reruns and the configured replan limit terminates the loop
measurement_note: Covered by the Phase 3 and Phase 4 targeted-replan tests.

title: A paused thread resumes after a fresh FastAPI process
expected_signal: same thread completes with exactly one idempotency-keyed fake effect
measurement_note: Requires the disposable PostgreSQL Phase 0 integration gate; not measured in the unit smoke run.

title: Duplicate start and resume delivery cannot advance twice
expected_signal: duplicate requests resolve to one checkpoint and one effect
measurement_note: Requires cross-process PostgreSQL advisory-lock and BullMQ delivery evidence.

title: Configured provider tool calling is verified before enablement
expected_signal: each enabled provider emits the requested tool call or remains unsupported
measurement_note: Credentialed provider checks are opt-in and network-dependent.

title: Arabic, English, and mixed-language outputs retain validation evidence
expected_signal: existing Strategy and Content language validators show no regression
measurement_note: Requires the reviewed bilingual evaluation dataset and provider mode selected for the run.
